prerequisites: Built CARGO_BIN_EXE_meerkat-recall; actual memory-backed storage for both backend implementations; owned temporary directories and named exports.
No external provider, server, Docker, production credentials, signing key, bearer file or recovery journal required by the inspector child.
Retain centrally reviewed all-features graph and bounded child-process/test supervision; no owner Cargo authorization.
reviewed_properties: Literal AST traversal with pinned parser, never query evaluation or database import.
Pinned Bytes display and decode use STANDARD_NO_PAD; local structural decoder matches this format.
Pinned object export uses bare or double-quoted keys; duplicate-aware scan precedes trust in parsed objects.
Record identities retain table and native key type; string-looking references remain strings; duplicate identities refuse.
Raw schema statements are included with explicit records because definitions can contain source-bearing literals.
Bounded manifest/payload reads reject leaf symlinks/nonregular files and check opened identity/size; manifest digest validates complete payload.
CLI inspection dispatch precedes management-client construction; complete raw records require explicit --json --include-records.
Compact report serialization is bounded before output; unknown value/statement/shape or exceeded limit refuses without a partial successful report.
open_scope_limits: A valid 2,000,000-byte source exceeds the fixed 1 MiB encoded-string limit. Full maximum-source physical qualification is UNMET until a finite complete envelope is reviewed.
Escaped JSON and nested serialized control payloads can exceed raw UTF-8 source size. Raising only to 2 MB is insufficient without accounting for actual layers.
Native geometry and versioned inserts are explicitly unsupported; their presence yields incomplete, never absence evidence.
Successful exported inventory does not inspect live persistent storage, WAL, media bytes or registered backup deletion.
CLI tests exercise a workspace-built binary, not the final installed native archive or container artifact.
